main.name: Agustín Musanti
main.heroTagline: I build dashboards, automations, and models that people actually use to make decisions. I work on reporting and automation at PwC, and in my own projects I apply data to agriculture and finance.
bio: I've worked with data since 2023 at PwC Argentina, where I went from Associate to Senior Associate with two promotions. Today I'm responsible for reporting automation on my team and support other teams as well.

Before automating anything, I rethink the process: which steps are unnecessary, what data is actually needed, and what decision the report has to enable. I work with Power BI, Python, SQL, and Power Automate, and I use generative AI every day to design, test, and implement solutions.
Outside of work I build projects with public data, mostly in agriculture and finance, because it's how I learn best: picking a real problem and solving it end to end.
main.currentFocus: Reporting, automation and applied AI · Data science applied to agriculture
